notes.title: "Chippy&Noppo" - v1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Chippy&Noppo".
We are pleased to announce the v1.0.1 update.
In this update, we have made the following fixes.

Fixed problems with the acquisition of some achievements.
A bug has been fixed where the following achievements could not be unlocked despite the conditions being met.
"Chippy&Noppo&You"
"Are you tired?"
"That was close!"
"Playful mindset to work"
"Chippy&Noppo&You&Your friend"

For those who were not able to unlock these achievements, you can now unlock it by fulfilling the conditions again.
Example:"Chippy&Noppo&You"
This can be unlocked by playing and clearing the "Basic Review" section from the "Choose  a Job" screen.

We apologise for the inconvenience.
We look forward to continue to work with "Chippy&Noppo".
